description: Load a flow configuration (inline JSON, or a reference this server can read; on your own machine a file path or an http(s) URL), or create a new empty flow by specifying a platform (web or server). Use the add-step prompt to add sources, destinations, transformers, or stores to the flow.

platform.description: Platform for new flows. Required when source is omitted. web = browser tracking, server = Node.js HTTP.

source.description: Flow source: inline JSON, or a reference this server can read (locally a file path such as ./flow.json or an http(s) URL). Omit to create a new flow.

name: flow_load
title: Load or Create Flow
